note: Twenty hand-written questions that have NO answer (docs/validation.md, T4). The right outcome is "not found": any value given is invented. Three kinds: an entity that does not exist, a relation that does not exist between real entities, a fact that no source can have. Never use them to tune the chain.

questions.why: The Zorvex language and Ilmar Tavenius do not exist.
questions.question: What is the date of birth (day, month and year) of the Estonian computer scientist Ilmar Tavenius, who created the Zorvex programming language in 1987?

questions.why: There was no Battle of Monteluro between Urbino and Ragusa in 1512; the condottiero is invented.
questions.question: In which municipality was the condottiero born who commanded the troops of the Republic of Ragusa at the Battle of Monteluro in 1512 against the Duchy of Urbino?

questions.why: The theorem and its authors are invented.
questions.question: What is the elevation above sea level of the home town of the Italian mathematician who in 1934, together with a Hungarian colleague, proved the Varnelli-Koss theorem on minimal surfaces?

questions.why: There is no ESA probe called Aurelia 3.
questions.question: What is the date of death (day, month and year) of the engineer who directed the project of the Aurelia 3 probe, launched by the European Space Agency in 1996 towards comet Tempel 1?

questions.why: The Duchy of Valsenia never existed.
questions.question: What is the postal code of the present-day municipality that was the capital of the Duchy of Valsenia, a state of central Italy that existed from 1432 to 1598?

questions.why: There is no Castrovillari Museum in Oslo, nor its founder.
questions.question: In what year was the Italian collector born who in 1921 founded the Castrovillari Museum of Etruscan art in Oslo?

questions.why: Verdi did not write an opera with this title, and there is no librettist.
questions.question: What is the date of birth (day, month and year) of the librettist of Giuseppe Verdi's opera "La regina di Tebe", staged at La Scala in 1861?

questions.why: Intel never made a processor code-named Orvieto.
questions.question: In which city was the chief designer of the Intel processor code-named "Orvieto", introduced in 2003, born?

questions.why: Isaac Newton never married.
questions.question: What is the date of birth (day, month and year) of the wife of the English physicist Isaac Newton, author of the Principia?

questions.why: Nikola Tesla never received the Nobel Prize.
questions.question: On what day, month and year was the ceremony held at which the inventor Nikola Tesla received the Nobel Prize in Physics?

questions.why: Kant was born in Königsberg, not in Italy: there is no Italian province.
questions.question: What is the elevation above sea level of the capital of the Italian province where the philosopher Immanuel Kant, author of the Critique of Pure Reason, was born?

questions.why: The Turing Award was created in 1966, after Turing's death: he never received it.
questions.question: In what year did the British mathematician Alan Turing receive the Turing Award of the Association for Computing Machinery?

questions.why: Vivaldi was a priest and had no known children.
questions.question: What is the date of death (day, month and year) of the eldest son of the Venetian composer Antonio Vivaldi, author of The Four Seasons?

questions.why: Everest lies between Nepal and China: there is no Swiss municipality.
questions.question: What is the postal code of the Swiss municipality on whose territory the summit of Mount Everest lies?

questions.why: Leonardo never earned a doctorate: there is no supervisor.
questions.question: What is the date of birth (day, month and year) of the professor who supervised Leonardo da Vinci's doctoral thesis at the University of Padua?

questions.why: Neither the day nor the year of Homer's birth is known.
questions.question: On what day, month and year was the Greek poet Homer, to whom the Iliad and the Odyssey are attributed, born?

questions.why: Spartacus's home village is not known.
questions.question: What is the current postal code of the Thracian village where the gladiator Spartacus, leader of the slave revolt against Rome, was born?

questions.why: Attila's burial place has never been found.
questions.question: What is the elevation above sea level of the exact place where Attila, king of the Huns who died in 453, is buried?

questions.why: The date of death of Pythagoras's mother is not known.
questions.question: What is the date of death (day, month and year) of the mother of the Greek philosopher and mathematician Pythagoras of Samos?

questions.why: Stonehenge is prehistoric: there is no known architect.
questions.question: In which city was the architect born who designed the megalithic complex of Stonehenge, in Wiltshire?
